text:
Monzo is a real UK bank, not just an app. The app is how you manage your account, but the bank itself is **Monzo Bank Limited**, authorised by the Prudential Regulation Authority and regulated by the PRA and FCA.

Eligible bank deposits are protected by the FSCS, subject to the applicable limit and exclusions. You can check Monzo’s status on the FCA’s Financial Services Register under firm reference number **730427**.
